test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The budget of any government is defined as:

options.text: an annual statement of the estimated receipts and expenditure of the government over the fiscal year
a monthly statement of the estimated receipts and expenditure of the government over the last month
a weekly statement of the estimated receipts and expenditure of the government over the last week
a biennial statement of the estimated receipts and expenditure of the government over the last two fiscal years

solution:
The correct answer is __**an annual statement of the estimated receipts and expenditure of the government over the fiscal year**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **government budget is an annual statement that estimates a government's income and expenses for the fiscal year.**
 
• It's also known a**s the Annual Financial Statement or Budget Statement. **
 
• A budget outlines the government's intended spending and revenue collection. 
 
• It's** usually prepared annually, keeping in mind the financial year.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **budget reveals the government's fiscal policy**, which focuses on the economy's stability and growth. 
 
• A budget helps the government focus on public sector companies by introducing policies to help them grow. 
 
• In India, **the financial year runs from April 1 to March 31.**
 
• The Constitution of India requires that the government lay out its estimated receipts and expenditures for each financial year before Parliament.
